verdict.rationale: Signifyd's REST API is processor-independent. Merchants call Checkout before sending authorization to "your payment processor"/"your Payment Gateway" (pre-auth), or call Sale after the processor authorizes (post-auth), so integration does not depend on any one processor's rails. Missing for 10: no named list of supported PSPs, gateways, or e-commerce platform integrations; no explicit documentation of multi-PSP setups; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
